$comment: Ceilings for `npm run perf:budget` / `perf:budget:ci` (bytes / counts). Set to the frozen v0.9.27 build (baseline.json), then ratcheted to the YAZ-2131 build in 7A (YAZ-2204). THE RATCHET (YAZ-2131): a change that shrinks a metric lowers its ceiling here in the same PR; raising one needs Yasin's OK in the PR description. `sizeTolerance` absorbs build-to-build jitter only (the same tree gives a DMG tens of bytes apart). drawingAssetBytes has no row on purpose: the drawing component is out of scope, so its bytes are reported, never gated.
